_comment: Frozen per-screen resolution for score columns whose SCORE.k_TYPE label ('Log10', 'Log10 (p-value)', 'Log10 (Corrected p-Value)') is unreliable: the SAME label covers 4 incompatible encodings across this corpus (log10(p), -log10(p), a signed -log10(p) with direction in the sign, and non-p-value magnitudes). classify_type() now routes these labels to role AMBIGUOUS_LOG instead of guessing, and harmonize_scores.py looks up the resolved semantics here by screen_id. Resolved 2026-07 via three independent forensic analyses (distribution-only, method-prior, and adversarial lenses) that cross-validated every screen with: the raw file's own HIT=YES/NO boundary (an author-supplied ground truth requiring no external assumption), a companion-column identity check (e.g. proving SCORE.2 == norm.sf(SCORE.1) to <1e-8 relative error for screens 1098/1099), and a core-essential-gene sign anchor for directional columns. All three lenses agreed on semantics for 18/20 screens; 1447/1448 are flagged needs_review because a broader essential-gene panel showed an inconsistent polarity versus their six same-paper siblings (1441-1446) — see notes. EXTENDED 2026-07 with 14 more screens hit by the SAME root cause under DIFFERENT labels ('RSA' via SIG_MAG clip(lower=0); 'RRA score' and 'MaGeCK Score' via SIG_P clip) -- each collapsed to a single distinct value. Those three labels are CORRECT for most screens, so they are not blanket-banned; instead this file is now consulted BY SCREEN_ID before any label-based classification, and each entry names its `column` explicitly. Transforms confirmed by the author's own HIT=YES/NO boundary except where noted. POLARITY of 1447/1448 was resolved 2026-07 (previously needs_review): the essential-gene anchor is simply not a valid orientation test for drug-contrast screens, and a cross-screen correlation test over all 8 siblings shows no sign inversion. See those entries.

transforms.identity: harmonized = x  (column is already on the correct scale/sign; do not call neglog10)
transforms.negate: harmonized = -x  (column is log10(p); negate to get -log10(p) so bigger = more significant)
transforms.quarantine: column is not a comparable magnitude at all; HARMONIZED_SCORE is left NaN so PERCENTILE_SCORE/ROBUST_Z_SCORE stay NULL. IS_HIT is unaffected (computed independently from the HIT column).
transforms._lookup: Resolution is per-SCREEN, not per-label: harmonize_scores.py checks this file by screen_id FIRST and only falls back to the SCORE.k_TYPE registry when a screen has no entry here.

1098.evidence: MA-plot 'Log10' is actually a one-sided Z-score: SCORE.2 (typed p-Value) == norm.sf(SCORE.1) to <1e-7 absolute error for 100% of 1416 genes. Must bypass BOTH the p-transform and the LLM sign override entirely -- use SCORE.1 as-is. TP53/CDKN1A/ARID3A (senescence bypass) top the positive tail, confirming + = knockout advantageous on RETICLE's axis.

1099.evidence: Same construction as 1098, same paper (PMID31219803): SCORE.2 == norm.sf(SCORE.1) to <1e-9 relative error. Bypass p-transform and sign override; use SCORE.1 as-is.

1175.evidence: ANALYSIS field states the formula: 'Ss=log10(10,000/Ranked position based on abundance)' -- a rank score, never a p-value. The 25 HIT=YES values (9.27-130.85) are on a DIFFERENT scale than the 1165 non-hit values (a smooth grid capped at exactly 4.000 = the formula's ceiling at rank 1) -- the two populations are not the same statistic, so no single continuous transform is comparable across genes. Already COVERAGE_TYPE=HIT_ONLY (FULL_SIZE_AVAILABLE=No); IS_HIT (computed independently from the HIT column) carries this screen instead.

Use as-is.

1446.evidence: MaGeCK drug-response arm (PMID32416067). Same family signature. Enriched tail (CDKN1A/CSK/ARID1A/FLCN/NF2/OTUD5) is a coherent resistance/suppressor set -> positive=enriched confirmed. Use as-is.

1447.evidence: MaGeCK signed -log10 p, JQ1 drug-response arm (PMID32416067). POLARITY RESOLVED 2026-07 by a cross-screen test over all 8 sibling screens of this deposition (18,457 shared genes, gene-level Spearman): the 4 proliferation screens (1441-1444) correlate +0.31..+0.40 with each other and their essentials are strongly negative, establishing the deposition's convention; all 4 JQ1 screens (1445-1448) correlate ~0 with them AND ~0 with each other (+0.02..+0.06 pairwise, never negative), which is what a drug-vs-untreated contrast looks like once essentiality cancels in both arms. A genuine sign flip would have made this screen correlate NEGATIVELY with 1445/1446 — it does not. The earlier essential-gene-anchor concern is explained and dismissed: (a) 1443 is the SAME resistant line (SUM159R) in a proliferation screen and its essential anchor is the STRONGEST of the set, so the resistant background is not what perturbs the anchor; (b) the anchor is inapplicable to ANY of the 4 drug-contrast screens, and 1445/1446 — accepted at high confidence by all three independent analyses — show the same anchor behaviour as this one; (c) a ratio-based drug contrast can even invert apparent essentiality, visible here as the -0.32/-0.42 correlations between same-cell-line proliferation/drug pairs (1443 vs 1448, 1444 vs 1447). Shared-pipeline fingerprint confirms one convention: all 8 screens saturate at |6.5898|+-0.0001 (the MaGeCK permutation p-floor).
1447.polarity_resolution: cross-screen sibling correlation + shared p-floor fingerprint

Proof it is a significance magnitude: spearman(SCORE.1, -log10(SCORE.2 p-Value)) = 1.0000 exactly. All 183 rows are HIT=YES (COVERAGE_TYPE=HIT_ONLY), so the HIT anchor is undefined here -- the monotone identity with the screen's own p-value column is the evidence instead. Larger = more significant -> identity.
